message: Oga, the money don enter, the goods no reach. Wetin you dey do? I need am sharp sharp.
How much for the complete set? If I buy all today, any free delivery?
I am placing the order for my office. 10 units. Please send bulk discount and total.
I want am. Make I pay half now, you go deliver, then I pay balance. Na so we dey do am here.
Please send the account number, I will make the transfer this morning.
Will pay when I receive. That is my final decision. No argument.
Hi! I love the dress. I want it in [color] size [size]. When can it get to me?
Please kindly confirm you can dispatch the order today. I will pay extra for same-day dispatch.
Please kindly share your business registration and CAC documents. I need to verify before any payment.
Wetin you dey wait for? I dey ready to pay since morning o.
Quick one - I want to order 3 of the [item]. Total cost with delivery please.
Please kindly confirm the [item] is in stock. I will make the transfer once confirmed.
Oga, why your price higher than the other person wey dey sell same thing?
Hi! Saw your TikTok video. Can I get the [item]? Also can you ship to [state]?
Boss, you no dey reply me since. Wetin happen? I dey ready to pay.
I would like to place an order for [item] in [color]. Please confirm the total cost and I will pay.
You dey scam person? See the price wey you post vs wetin you dey charge now.
If I pay now, when you go deliver? Tomorrow?
Abeg give me small time. The money go enter before close of work today.
Wetin be your cheapest? Na just small money I get.
